critiques.claim: Requirements tracing is an accounting exercise connecting requirements to design, code, and test cases.
critiques.critique: Traditional matrices record *that* a link exists, but omit *why* it exists, who approved it, what evidence supports it, what assumptions it depends on, and what operational incident should trigger reconsideration.
critiques.nuance: Forward/backward matrices remain the mandatory baseline compliance standard for regulated engineering.

extensions.title: Topic 9.6 Assurance Cases & Evidence Graphs
extensions.summary: Bi-directional evidence graphs capturing approval rationale, confidence levels, and operational triggers.
